message.content:
Sure! Here’s exactly what you’d send to VirusTotal so that your **`key_four`** token registers “malicious” for the IP 22.242.75.136:

---

### 1️⃣ Endpoint  
```
POST https://www.virustotal.com/api/v2/ips/22.242.75.136/vote
```

> *If you’re using the newer v3 API, replace `api.v2` with `api.v3`, keep the same path (`/ipv4/<IP>/votes`) and adjust headers slightly.*

### 2️⃣ Headers  

| Header                | Value                                 |
|-----------------------|----------------------------------------|
| `x-apikey`            | `<your_key_four>`                      |
| `Content-Type`        | `application/json`                     |

*(In older docs the auth header was called `X‑AUTH‑TOKEN`; both work.)*

### 3️⃣ Request body  

```json
{
  "type":"vote",
  "attributes":{
    "verdict":"malicious"
  }
}
```

That matches the JSON you already drafted – great!

### 4️⃣ Example cURL Command  

```bash
curl -s \
     --request POST \
     --url https://www.virustotal.com/api/v2/ips/22.242.75.136/vote \
     --header "x-apikey: <YOUR_KEY_FOUR>" \
     --header "content-type: application/json" \
     --data '{"type":"vote","attributes":{"verdict":"malicious"}}'
```

Replace `<YOUR_KEY_FOUR>` with the actual value of your key.

### 5️⃣ What Happens Next?

* If everything is correct, VirusTotal will return a `200 OK` response containing the newly created vote object (including its ID).
* Your vote becomes part of the public dataset after the usual propagation delay (~24–48 h).

### 6️⃣ Things To Keep In Mind

| Item                          | Why It Matters                                                                                           |
|-------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Rate Limits                   | You’re limited to ~30 requests/minute per API key. Exceeding this triggers temporary bans.               |
| Vote Reversal                 | Once submitted, you can’t delete a vote via the API—only update it to another verdict (“benign”, “undetermined”). |
| Duplicate Votes              | Submitting the same verdict twice from the same key has no effect beyond the first submission.           |
| Data Privacy                  | Do NOT share private keys publicly.                                                                       |

---

#### Quick Test

If you run the above cURL locally, you’ll see something like:

```json
{
  "_id": "some_vote_id",
  "created_at": "...",
  "updated_at": "...",
  "type": "vote",
  "relationships": { ... },
  "attributes": {
      "verdict": "malicious",
      ...
  }
}
```

That confirms the vote went through successfully.
